summary: Sankey from Chat, Code and API to three models, with particles streaming in proportion to traffic; hovering a band isolates it.
accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` that lists every flow, for example `Chat: 12k to Large, 26k to Medium, 8k to Small`.
Node names and totals are text beside the chart.
The band tooltip appears on hover only.
motion: With reduced motion, bands appear at once without growing in, no particles stream and drawing stops.
notes: Data is built in: three sources, three models and 100k requests in total. It cannot be configured.
The chart is 220px tall and fills the width between the two label columns.

data.note: The sources, models and 100k request split are invented; only `label` can be set.
